purpose: Verify that explicit expert camera, lens, focal, aperture, framing, lighting, stock, color, texture and preservation choices remain locked while AUTO fills only compatible missing values.

scoring.pass_condition: Every feasible explicit value must survive unchanged. Genuine conflicts must be classified and surfaced rather than silently normalized. Provider limitations may trigger semantic translation but may not erase the lock.
critical_failures: silently changing a user-specified focal length, aperture, camera, lens, angle, shot size, stock, lighting or preservation requirement
treating an unconventional but possible combination as invalid merely because it is unusual
solving provider incompatibility by changing the universal shot
relabeling an explicit user value as AUTO or inferred
using a provider preset that contradicts one or more field-level locks
claiming full success when mutually impossible locked outcomes remain unresolved

cases.prompt: Portrait in 70mm format, 25mm lens, f/1.2, low angle. Fill everything else automatically.
must_not: replace 25mm with a more typical portrait focal length
cases.reason: Canonical manual-camera behavior: explicit values are locks, not suggestions.

cases.prompt: Use a 14mm rectilinear lens very close to the foreground hand. I want huge near/far scale exaggeration but absolutely no fisheye curvature and straight architecture behind.
must_not: curve the background to express wideness
cases.reason: Wide-angle perspective exaggeration and optical fisheye distortion are separate systems.

cases.prompt: Keep f/1.2 locked but I want the face and the building several meters behind to both feel clearly readable.
must_not: promise impossible deep focus if geometry cannot support it
cases.reason: Depth conflict must be solved through unlocked geometry first and surfaced if the requested result remains physically contradictory.

cases.prompt: Make it feel like a 65/70mm large-format capture, but finish it with VHS color bleed and tape artifacts.
must_not: collapse capture format and post/finish into one axis
cases.reason: Acquisition-scale intent and downstream analog-video finish can coexist.

cases.prompt: ARRI ALEXA 35 character, Cooke S4 lens, 35mm focal length, f/4, chest-height camera, medium shot, soft window key from camera-left, no haze, no flare.
must_not: add haze because the shot is cinematic
add flare because Cooke glass was named
change aperture to create more bokeh
cases.reason: Multiple simultaneous expert locks must survive intact.

cases.prompt: Magnific prompt only: use a 40mm focal length and Leitz SUMMILUX-C character. Do not substitute another lens even if Magnific has no exact native control.
expected_provider_behavior: leave incompatible native focal/lens selector neutral or Auto when needed
translate locked visual intent in prompt language
disclose semantic translation if structured output is exposed
must_not: swap the lens for another native preset
cases.reason: Provider enum gaps do not erase universal locks.

cases.prompt: True 90-degree top-down camera, all five vehicles facing the same direction, same formation, same spacing. Only camera viewpoint may change.
must_not: use a high three-quarter view instead of true top-down
cases.reason: Geometric and preservation locks are equal first-class constraints.

cases.prompt: Keep this exact frozen moment: same pose, gaze, expression, hands, props, lighting and shadows. Move only the camera to an over-the-shoulder position behind the father, looking down.
must_not: change body pose to make the OTS easier
cases.reason: Frozen-moment camera changes must preserve scene state while allowing parallax/visibility changes caused by the new camera position.

cases.prompt: Kodak VISION3 500T is locked, but keep the image clean and restrained with barely visible grain and no visible halation.
must_not: add strong grain because film was selected
cases.reason: Stock, grain and halation are separate systems.

cases.prompt: Use hard noon sun and keep it noon. Do not turn this into golden hour. Preserve the white concrete walls and natural skin color.
must_not: warm the entire scene to make it cinematic
recover every shadow into flat HDR
cases.reason: AUTO must complete around difficult real lighting rather than rewriting a locked condition.
